prompt: Using the installed @acmelabs/design-system package and its matching release records, create a standalone HTML notification settings form. It needs a labeled email input, a plan choice, a notification switch, Save and Reset. Save should show the browser FormData as a receipt without sending a request. Use selective browser modules. Supply the complete runnable file and test it in a browser.
assertions: All browser URLs use the same exact installed package version and each used element is defined.
Submitting changed values produces a receipt from actual FormData with the expected control names and values.
Reset restores the initial submitted values and required validation remains native.
The artifact has no full-library or devtools import and no duplicate form state implementation.
